graphs.caption: Box with internal lines W,Q,Q,ωW. One Δ1 vertex; its ghost leg is external. Symmetry factor 1; closed-loop sign +1 (no closed fermion or ghost loop), as in the report's tables. The package's Wick sign in the leg order of its vertex functions (Dirac conjugates before fermions, antighosts before ghosts) is +1; it is a different quantity.
